recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Any future work should be handled through narrower terminology trackers that identify a specific missing or incorrect rule, page, or artifact rather than reopening this completed broad mining task.
issue_request: FHIR-13869 asked the Vocabulary work group to mine HL7 v3 Core Principles for vocabulary guidance that should be propagated to FHIR terminology resources, operations, services, and/or profiles before the terminology content went normative. The issue was Published/Persuasive for STU3, and Jira records that the committee and submitter believed the work was done to the degree possible.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-13869 or GF#13869 was found. The available history instead shows substantial terminology documentation work in the 2018 normative-ballot period across the terminology page and CodeSystem, ValueSet, ConceptMap, and terminology-service-adjacent material, which aligns with Jira's broad completion comment rather than a single issue-specific patch.
additional_context: The current Using Codes page links to HL7 v3 Core Principles and explains code systems, value sets, system identifiers, binding strengths, conformance expectations, legacy data, and terminology service linkage. The active CodeSystem, ValueSet, ConceptMap, and Terminology Service pages also carry or cross-link Core Principles-based terminology guidance. A later reconciled issue, FHIR-39044, confirms the current CodeSystem/ValueSet introduction wording intentionally relies on HL7 v3 Core Principles.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The seed request was a broad pre-normative review rather than a specific missing current-build requirement, and the current active source already conveys the relevant Core Principles guidance across the terminology pages. Additional prose would be redundant and could create future maintenance drift.

related_jiras.note: Later R5 terminology wording issue confirmed that the CodeSystem and ValueSet introductions intentionally reference HL7 v3 Core Principles; it is already represented on the combined branch.
